top_signals.title: Xi seizes Trump detente to seek lasting gains on trade and Taiwan
top_signals.summary: Underneath many of U.S. President Donald Trump's grand gestures at his summit with Xi Jinping, there were signs of the limits to their relationship.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Man charged in $16 million crypto ‘massive pig butchering’ scam
top_signals.summary: A man was charged for his role in defrauding someone of millions of dollars' worth of crypto in a "massive pig butchering" scam.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
